evidence.title: San Bovio datacenter construction update
evidence.excerpt: Microsoft's July 2026 update says the San Bovio construction site has begun unspecified preliminary activities after approvals were completed, while initial principal works are planned for September 2026.

metadata.retrieval_method: curl --fail --location --compressed with retries disabled and the DataCenterAtlas research user agent
metadata.retrieved_at_semantics: Request-start UTC recorded by the capture harness; the response HTTP Date can be the same second or one second later.
metadata.status_as_of_normalization: 2026-07-01 is the conservative month-start representation of the source's July 2026 update label, not an asserted observation day.
metadata.status_scope: The source supports site preparation only because it identifies unspecified preliminary construction-site activity. It explicitly forecasts initial principal works for September 2026, so no stronger construction stage is imported.
metadata.approval_scope: The page says all approvals were in place after a favorable June 2026 Services Conference outcome. Approval is not treated as proof of principal physical construction.
metadata.redevelopment_guardrail: Completed environmental remediation and demolition of the former Postalmarket building are historical redevelopment activities and are not recast as datacenter shell or building construction.
metadata.address_scope: The source identifies the former Postalmarket site in San Bovio, Peschiera Borromeo, greater Milan. Via Trieste 24 is a separate former bar being transferred to the municipality, not the datacenter address.
metadata.coordinate_basis: The source publishes no site coordinate. The entity snapshot is intentionally coordinate-free and preserves only the authoritative former-site/locality description; it is not a geocode, parcel, footprint, building centroid, or unique-site claim.
metadata.metric_guardrail: Photovoltaic-panel area, reused material, recycled steel, avoided carbon dioxide, landscaping, and noise-model values are not site power, energy use, PUE, or IT capacity. No typed capacity, workload, operating model, completion, or operation claim is imported.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Satellite imagery and computer vision play no role in identity or lifecycle status.
